verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (logo, can, headline, list, CTA), but the FIZZBANG logo is shrunk to a tiny pill sitting left of the centre axis. The can is undersized, and the flavour list is out of the original order, ragged and stepped, with dots and type shrinking down the list. B has a strong hero can, but the CTA is buried as a tiny button jammed beside the logo in the top-right corner. The bottom third is dead space, and its list is also out of order and stair-stepped and indented, so its hierarchy failure is worse.
